description: Unique identifier for the grid cell (carried through unchanged from the input grid).
Sub-column index of this cell within its parent 25m grid cell (from the sub16 grid layer).
Sub-row index of this cell within its parent 25m grid cell (from the sub16 grid layer).

Area-weighted majority-wins main label. Whichever of the 4 source layers (Field abandonment, Natural disturbance, 1938 hurricane, Silviculture treatment) covers the largest fraction of the cell wins; the label text is that layer's most recent dated event in the cell. "Not Mapped" if no source layer overlaps the cell.
Fraction of the cell's area covered by the layer named in disturb_majority. 0 if Not Mapped.

Time-based main label. The class of whichever dated disturbance event in the cell (across all 4 source layers) is most recent. Silviculture entries that are monitoring-only (inspection/photo/measurement, no structural keyword) are excluded when picking "most recent" - they still appear in disturb_history, just never set this field. "Not Mapped" if no disturbance event overlaps the cell.
valid_values: Agricultural abandonment | Agricultural cutting | 1938 hurricane | Natural disturbance | Silviculture - clearcut | Silviculture - salvage | Silviculture - regen harvest | Silviculture - thinning | Silviculture - other | Not Mapped

description: The most-recent disturbance event's raw text plus year, e.g. "Silviculture - clearcut (1962)". "Not Mapped" if none.
Year of the most-recent disturbance event (the one behind disturb_recent_class / disturb_recent_label). NA if Not Mapped or if the cell's only events are undated.
2022 minus disturb_recent_yr (2022 is a fixed reference year, not "today" - re-derive if a different reference date is needed). NA if disturb_recent_yr is NA.

Full chronological list of every dated event on record for the cell (oldest to newest), across all 4 source layers, semicolon-separated as "<event type> (<year>)". Undated events are appended last, tagged "(undated)". "Not Mapped" if no source layer overlaps the cell.

valid_values: year) pairs listed in disturb_history. 0 if Not Mapped.

description: Earliest dated event year in disturb_history. NA if Not Mapped or all events in the cell are undated.
Latest dated event year in disturb_history. NA if Not Mapped or all events in the cell are undated.

Largest area fraction any single source-layer polygon covers of the cell - a rough confidence indicator (low values mean the cell is only marginally touched by mapped source polygons, e.g. a sliver at the edge). 0 if Not Mapped.
Cell boundary. CRS matches the input grid file (WGS84 / UTM 18N for the current HARV grids).
